title: Cap Light 300 Lumen – Clip-On LED Headlamp
descriptionHtml:
Light where you look – hands free

When you're fishing, running or tinkering in the dark, you need light exactly where you're looking. Holding a flashlight at the same time makes it both awkward and unsafe.

Clip it onto your cap and see

This light clips easily onto your cap and shines 300 lumens right where you look. It is light and battery-powered, so you always have light close at hand.

Features

  • 300 lumen brightness
  • Clips easily onto the cap
  • 11 LEDs for wide light
  • Light and battery-powered
  • Great for fishing, running and camping

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
